jobs.title: Compliance Program Manager (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Shape and drive a company-wide compliance program in a dynamic international environment. As Compliance Program Manager, you will coordinate governance, regulatory monitoring, audits, and continuous improvement activities while partnering with stakeholders across Quality, Sustainability, Product Compliance, Legal, Information Security, Supply Chain, and HR.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the enterprise Compliance Management Framework, including governance, accountability models, RACI structures, and integration into the Integrated Management System (IMS).

• Drive cross-functional compliance governance and foster collaboration with Compliance Category Owners and key stakeholders across business functions and regions.

• Monitor regulatory developments, maintain the Compliance Radar and Dashboard, and provide compliance insights and updates for management reviews.

• Manage the risk-based, multi-year integrated compliance audit program across functions and global locations.

• Coordinate audit preparation, scheduling, execution support, documentation, reporting, and collaboration with internal audit teams.

• Track compliance findings, corrective actions, deadlines, and escalation of overdue actions through a centralized compliance process.

• Coordinate updates to IMS processes, roles and responsibilities based on regulatory changes, audit findings, compliance gaps, and identified improvement opportunities while promoting best practice sharing.

• Prepare compliance reports, facilitate biannual compliance reviews, and support the implementation and transition of the integrated compliance framework into business-as-usual operations.

Required Expertise

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Quality Management, Engineering, Life Sciences, Law, Finance, or a related discipline.

• Experience in compliance, risk, and quality management within an international organization.

• Strong knowledge of integrated management systems, internal auditing, corrective action management, and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Proven project management experience coordinating complex, cross-functional initiatives with strong execution and follow-up discipline.

• Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority and communicate effectively with management and executive leadership.

• Interest in leveraging AI, automation, and digital tools to enhance compliance monitoring, reporting, and business processes.

• Fluent in English and German; additional languages are considered an advantage.

• Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills, with a willingness to travel globally (10–20%).

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone. .

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione

Formare e guidare un programma di conformità a livello aziendale in un ambiente dinamico internazionale. In qualità di Responsabile del Programma di Compliance, coordina le attività di governance, monitoraggio delle normative, audit e miglioramento continuo, collaborando con gli stakeholder tra Qualità, Sostenibilità, Compliance dei prodotti, Legale, Sicurezza delle informazioni, Supply Chain e HR.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare e coordinare il Quadro di Gestione Compliance aziendale, tra cui governance, modelli di responsabilità, strutture RACI e integrazione nel Sistema di Gestione Integrata (IMS).

• Guidare la governance della conformità multifunzionale e promuovere la collaborazione con Compliance Categoria Proprietari e stakeholder chiave tra funzioni e regioni aziendali.

• Monitorare gli sviluppi normativi, mantenere il Radar di conformità e Dashboard, e fornire informazioni di conformità e aggiornamenti per le recensioni di gestione.

• Gestisci il programma di audit di conformità integrato pluriennale e basato sul rischio attraverso funzioni e sedi globali.

• Coordinate la preparazione dell'audit, la pianificazione, il supporto per l'esecuzione, la documentazione, la segnalazione e la collaborazione con i team di audit interni.

• Traccia i risultati di conformità, le azioni correttive, le scadenze e l'escalation di azioni in ritardo attraverso un processo di conformità centralizzato.

• Coordinare gli aggiornamenti ai processi, ai ruoli e alle responsabilità di IMS in base ai cambiamenti normativi, ai risultati di audit, alle lacune di conformità e alle opportunità di miglioramento identificate, promuovendo la migliore condivisione delle pratiche.

• Preparare i rapporti di conformità, facilitare le revisioni di conformità semestrali e sostenere l'attuazione e la transizione del quadro di conformità integrato nelle operazioni business-as-usual.

Competenza richiesta

• Laurea o equivalente in Business Administration, Gestione della Qualità, Ingegneria, Scienze della Vita, Legge, Finanza, o una disciplina relativa.

• Esperienza nella conformità, nel rischio e nella gestione della qualità all'interno di un'organizzazione internazionale.

• Forte conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione integrata, controllo interno, gestione delle azioni correttive e metodologie di miglioramento continuo.

• Provata esperienza di gestione del progetto coordinando iniziative complesse e interfunzionali con forte esecuzione e disciplina di follow-up.

• Capacità di influenzare le parti interessate senza autorità diretta e comunicare efficacemente con la gestione e la leadership esecutiva.

• Interesse a sfruttare strumenti AI, automazione e digitale per migliorare il monitoraggio della conformità, reporting e processi aziendali.

• Fluente in inglese e tedesco; lingue aggiuntive sono considerate un vantaggio.

• Forte analitica, comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e capacità organizzative, con la volontà di viaggiare a livello globale (10-20%).

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti iniziano con persone dedicate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e adottiamo un ambiente per avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il supporto nei dipartimenti aiutano le idee a muoversi rapidamente in soluzioni del mondo reale, perché raggiungiamo più insieme di quanto mai potremmo soli.

Informazioni su Belimo

Belimo è leader del mercato globale nello sviluppo, produzione e vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'energia dei sistemi di riscaldamento, ventilazione e climatizzazione. Il focus del nostro core business è sugli attuatori ammortizzatori, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata sulla Borsa Svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Compensazioni e vantaggi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, equa e competitiva. Offriamo la paga che riflette le vostre abilità, esperienza, istruzione e posizione. Oltre al compenso, potrai beneficiare di un pacchetto completo di ricompense progettato per supportare la tua salute, benessere finanziario e successo a lungo termine. Belimo è orgoglioso di essere un Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung

Gestalten und vorantreiben Sie ein unternehmensweites Compliance-Programm in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld. Als Compliance Program Manager koordinieren Sie Governance, regulatorische Überwachung, Audits und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsaktivitäten und arbeiten mit Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Qualität, Nachhaltigkeit, Produkt-Compliance, Recht, Informationssicherheit, Supply Chain und HR zusammen.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Führen und koordinieren Sie das Enterprise Compliance Management Framework, einschließlich Governance, Rechenschaftsmodelle, RACI-Strukturen und Integration in das Integrated Management System (IMS).

• Führen Sie eine funktionsübergreifende Compliance-Governance voran und fördern Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit Compliance-Kategorieninhabern und wichtigen Stakeholdern in Geschäftsfunktionen und Regionen.

• Überwachen Sie regulatorische Entwicklungen, pflegen Sie das Compliance-Radar und Dashboard und bieten Sie Compliance-Insights und Updates für Management-Überprüfungen.

• Verwalten Sie das risikobasierte, mehrjährige integrierte Compliance-Auditprogramm über Funktionen und globale Standorte hinweg.

• Koordinieren Sie die Vorbereitung, Planung, Ausführungsunterstützung, Dokumentation, Berichterstattung und Zusammenarbeit mit internen Auditteams.

• Verfolgen Sie Compliance-Ergebnisse, Korrekturmaßnahmen, Fristen und Eskalation überfälliger Maßnahmen durch einen zentralisierten Compliance-Prozess.

• Koordinieren Sie Aktualisierungen von IMS-Prozessen, -Rollen und -Verantwortlichkeiten auf der Grundlage von regulatorischen Änderungen, Prüfungsergebnissen, Compliance-Lücken und identifizierten Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten, während Sie den Austausch bewährter Verfahren fördern.

• Erstellen Sie Compliance-Berichte, erleichtern Sie halbjährliche Compliance-Überprüfungen und unterstützen Sie die Implementierung und den Übergang des integrierten Compliance-Frameworks in den Business-as-usual-Betrieb.

Erforderliches Fachwissen

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation in Business Administration, Qualitätsmanagement, Engineering, Life Sciences, Recht, Finanzen oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• Erfahrung im Compliance-, Risiko- und Qualitätsmanagement innerhalb einer internationalen Organisation.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse über integrierte Managementsysteme, interne Revision, Management von Korrekturmaßnahmen und Methoden zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

• Bewährte Projektmanagementerfahrung in der Koordination komplexer, funktionsübergreifender Initiativen mit starker Ausführungs- und Folgedisziplin.

• Fähigkeit, Stakeholder ohne direkte Autorität zu beeinflussen und effektiv mit dem Management und der Führungskräfte zu kommunizieren.

• Interesse daran, KI, Automatisierung und digitale Tools zu nutzen, um Compliance-Überwachung, Reporting und Geschäftsprozesse zu verbessern.

• Fließend Englisch und Deutsch; zusätzliche Sprachen gelten als Vorteil.

• Starke analytische, Kommunikations-, Stakeholder-Management- und organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit der Bereitschaft, weltweit zu reisen (10-20%).

Menschen in Belimo

Intelligente Gebäude beginnen mit engagierten Menschen. Wir bringen talentierte Menschen zusammen und fördern ein Umfeld, um erfolgreich zu sein. Bei Belimo helfen Respekt, Vertrauen und Unterstützung abteilungsübergreifend, Ideen schnell in reale Lösungen zu bringen, weil wir gemeinsam mehr erreichen, als wir es jemals alleine könnten.

Über Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in der Entwicklung, Produktion und dem Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Steuerung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. Der Fokus unseres Kerngeschäfts liegt auf Dämpferaktoren, Regelventilen, Sensoren und Zählern. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Swiss Exchange (SIX) notiert.

Entschädigung und Vorteile

Bei Belimo glauben wir an eine faire, gerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Wir bieten eine Bezahlung an, die Ihre Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Ihren Standort widerspiegelt. Über die Entschädigung hinaus profitieren Sie von einem umfassenden Belohnungspaket, das Ihre Gesundheit, Ihr finanzielles Wohlbefinden und Ihren langfristigen Erfolg unterstützt. Belimo ist stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation

Former et piloter un programme de conformité à l'échelle de l'entreprise dans un environnement international dynamique. En tant que gestionnaire du programme de conformité, vous coordonnerez les activités de gouvernance, de surveillance réglementaire, de vérification et d'amélioration continue tout en vous associant à des intervenants dans les domaines de la qualité, de la durabilité, de la conformité des produits, du droit, de la sécurité de l'information, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des RH.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger et coordonner le Cadre de gestion de la conformité de l'organisation, y compris la gouvernance, les modèles de responsabilisation, les structures de l'ICRA et l'intégration au Système de gestion intégrée (SGI).

• Favoriser la gouvernance de la conformité interfonctionnelle et favoriser la collaboration avec les propriétaires de la catégorie de conformité et les principaux intervenants dans toutes les fonctions opérationnelles et les régions.

• Surveiller l'évolution de la réglementation, maintenir le radar de conformité et le tableau de bord et fournir des renseignements et des mises à jour sur la conformité pour les examens de la direction.

• Gérer le programme pluriannuel de vérification intégrée de la conformité axé sur les risques, dans toutes les fonctions et dans les lieux mondiaux.

• Coordonner la préparation de la vérification, le calendrier, le soutien à l'exécution, la documentation, les rapports et la collaboration avec les équipes de vérification interne.

• Suivre les constatations de conformité, les mesures correctives, les échéances et l'escalade des mesures en retard au moyen d'un processus de conformité centralisé.

• Coordonner les mises à jour des processus, des rôles et des responsabilités du SGI en fonction des changements réglementaires, des constatations de la vérification, des lacunes en matière de conformité et des possibilités d'amélioration cernées tout en favorisant le partage des pratiques exemplaires.

• Préparer des rapports sur la conformité, faciliter les examens semestriels de la conformité et appuyer la mise en oeuvre et la transition du cadre intégré de conformité aux activités courantes.

Expertise requise

• Baccalauréat ou diplôme équivalent en administration des affaires, gestion de la qualité, génie, sciences de la vie, droit, finances ou une discipline connexe.

• Expérience de la conformité, des risques et de la gestion de la qualité au sein d'une organisation internationale.

• Bonne connaissance des systèmes de gestion intégrée, de la vérification interne, de la gestion des mesures correctives et des méthodes d'amélioration continue.

• Expérience éprouvée de la gestion de projet en coordonnant des initiatives complexes et interfonctionnelles avec une solide exécution et une discipline de suivi.

• Capacité d'influencer les intervenants sans pouvoir direct et de communiquer efficacement avec la direction et le leadership exécutif.

• Intérêt à tirer parti de l'intelligence artificielle, de l'automatisation et des outils numériques pour améliorer la surveillance de la conformité, les rapports et les processus opérationnels.

• Fluent en anglais et en allemand; les langues supplémentaires sont considérées comme un avantage.

• Forte capacité d'analyse, de communication, de gestion des intervenants et d'organisation, avec une volonté de voyager à l'échelle mondiale (10-20%).

Les gens de Belimo

Les bâtiments intelligents commencent par des gens dévoués. Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et nous favorisons un environnement propice au succès. Chez Belimo, le respect, la confiance et le soutien à travers les ministères aident les idées à évoluer rapidement vers des solutions réelles, parce que nous obtenons plus ensemble que nous ne le pouvions jamais seul.

À propos de Belimo

Belimo est le leader mondial dans le développement, la production et la vente de dispositifs de terrain pour le contrôle énergétique des systèmes de chauffage, de ventilation et de climatisation. Nos activités principales sont les actionneurs d'amortisseurs, les vannes de contrôle, les capteurs et les compteurs. Fondée en 1975, la société est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

Chez Belimo, nous croyons en une rémunération juste, équitable et concurrentielle. Nous offrons une rémunération qui reflète vos compétences, votre expérience, votre éducation et votre emplacement. Au-delà de la rémunération, vous bénéficierez d'un ensemble complet de récompenses conçu pour soutenir votre santé, votre bien-être financier et votre succès à long terme. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Instandhaltungsfachmann/-frau (100%)
jobs.description:
Halte unsere operativen Bereiche am Laufen und sorge dafür, dass Stillstände gar nicht erst zum Problem werden. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, treibst Verbesserungen voran und bringst deine Expertise dort ein, wo sie wirklich Wirkung zeigt.

Was wirst du tun

•
 Schnelle und fachgerechte Behebung von Störungen und Anlagenstillständen im Schichtbetrieb

•
 Überwachung von Anlagenelementen sowie proaktives Handeln gemäss Service Level Agreements

•
 Durchführung und Koordination geplanter Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten

•
 Erstellung und Optimierung von Instandhaltungsplänen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Instandhaltungsplanung

•
 Sicherstellung von Qualitätsstandards und kontinuierliche Verbesserung durch Erkennen von Schwachstellen

•
 Gewährleistung von Sicherheit, Verfügbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit der Anlagen

•
 Mitarbeit bei Inbetriebnahmen, Umbauten sowie bei Instandhaltungs- und abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten

•
 Unterstützung, Schulung und fachliche Anleitung von Mitarbeitenden

• Gelegentliches Arbeiten in der Höhe und somit sicheres Anwenden der PSAgA

Arbeitszeiten

• Grundsätzliche Arbeitszeiten im Schichtmodell zwischen 6 Uhr morgens und 23 Uhr abends in 2 Schichten

• Bereitschaft für gelegentliche Sondereinsätze (bspw. Samstag, Sonntag und Nacht)

Wer du bist

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung im Bereich Automation, Elektrotechnik, Informatik oder vergleichbar und abgeschlossene Weiterbildung als Instandhaltungsfachmann/-frau (eidg. FA) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Mind. 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen und somit gewandt in der Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung von SPS-Steuerungen (Beckhoff von Vorteil)

• Gute Kenntnisse von industriellen Netzwerken und Erfahrung im Bereich ICT-Infrastruktur, Windows-Systeme und Netzwerkkomponenten

• Erfahrung im 2nd-Level-Support oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Supportfunktion von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse in Mechanik, Pneumatik und Hydraulik von Vorteil

• Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt und ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung

• Sehr gute Deutsch- (mind. B2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B1)

•
 Strukturierte, proaktive und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit schneller Auffassungsgabe, hoher Eigenverantwortung und Flexibilität

Wer wir sind

Bei Belimo sind wir stolz darauf, unser Unternehmen zu einem lohnenden Arbeitsplatz zu machen. Unsere Führungskräfte sind werteorientiert und fördern neue Ideen in ihren Teams auf der ganzen Welt. Durch unsere Leidenschaft schaffen unsere Mitarbeiter nicht nur erstaunliche Produkte, sondern revolutionieren auch die HLK-Branche. Die Investition in unsere Mitarbeitenden ist das Herzstück von Belimo, wenn es darum geht, verschiedene kreative Talente zu engagieren, um ein branchenführendes Unternehmen aufzubauen. Der Erfolg unserer Unternehmensmarke basiert auf der Kompetenz und dem Engagement jedes Einzelnen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Tenere le nostre aree operative in esecuzione e assicurarsi che i tempi di fermo non diventino un problema in primo luogo. Con noi, si assume la responsabilità, guidare miglioramenti e portare la vostra esperienza in cui ha davvero un impatto.

Cosa farai

•
Correzione rapida e professionale dei guasti e dei tempi di fermo degli impianti durante il funzionamento a turni

•
Monitoraggio degli elementi vegetali e dell'azione proattiva in conformità agli accordi di livello di servizio

•
Attuazione e coordinamento dei lavori di manutenzione e manutenzione previsti

•
Creazione e ottimizzazione dei piani di manutenzione in collaborazione con la pianificazione della manutenzione

•
Garantire standard di qualità e miglioramento continuo identificando le vulnerabilità

•
Garantire sicurezza, disponibilità e affidabilità degli impianti

•
Collaborazione in commissioni, conversioni, progetti di manutenzione e cross-departmental

•
Supporto, formazione e orientamento professionale dei dipendenti

• Lavoro occasionale in altezza e quindi applicazione sicura di PSAgA

Ore lavorative

• Ore lavorative di base nel modello a turni dalle 6 alle 11 in 2 turni

• Prontezza per missioni speciali occasionali (ad esempio sabato, domenica e notte)

Chi sei

• Formazione tecnica completata nel campo dell'automazione, dell'ingegneria elettrica, dell'informatica o formazione comparabile e completata come specialista di manutenzione (Federal School) o qualifica comparabile

• Mente. 5 anni di esperienza nella manutenzione degli impianti di produzione e quindi qualificati nella risoluzione dei problemi e nella risoluzione dei problemi dei controlli PLC (Beckhoff di vantaggio)

• Buona conoscenza delle reti industriali e dell'esperienza nell'infrastruttura ICT, sistemi Windows e componenti di rete

• L'esperienza nel supporto di secondo livello o una funzione di supporto tecnico comparabile è un vantaggio

• La conoscenza della meccanica, pneumatica e idraulica è vantaggiosa

• Esperienza nel contatto diretto con i clienti e forte orientamento al servizio

• Ottimo tedesco (minimo B2) e buone abilità inglesi (minimo B1)

•
Personalità strutturata, proattiva e orientata al team con comprensione rapida, elevata responsabilità personale e flessibilità

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e promuovono nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, ma anche rivoluzionano l'industria HVAC. Investire nei nostri dipendenti è al centro di Belimo quando si tratta di coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per costruire una società leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Keep our operational areas running and make sure that downtimes do not become a problem in the first place. With us, you take responsibility, drive improvements and bring your expertise where it really has an impact.

What will you do

•
Rapid and professional correction of faults and plant downtimes during shift operation

•
Monitoring of plant elements and proactive action in accordance with Service Level Agreements

•
Implementation and coordination of planned maintenance and maintenance work

•
Creation and optimization of maintenance plans in cooperation with maintenance planning

•
Ensuring quality standards and continuous improvement by identifying vulnerabilities

•
Ensuring the safety, availability and reliability of installations

•
Collaboration in commissionings, conversions, maintenance and cross-departmental projects

•
Support, training and professional guidance of employees

• Occasional work at height and thus safe application of PSAgA

Working hours

• Basic working hours in the shift model between 6 a.m. and 11 p.m. in 2 shifts

• Readiness for occasional special missions (e.g. Saturday, Sunday and night)

Who you are

• Completed technical training in the field of automation, electrical engineering, computer science or comparable and completed further training as a maintenance specialist (Federal School) or comparable qualification

• Mind. 5 years of experience in the maintenance of production plants and thus skilled in troubleshooting and troubleshooting of PLC controls (Beckhoff of advantage)

• Good knowledge of industrial networks and experience in ICT infrastructure, Windows systems and network components

• Experience in 2nd-level support or a comparable technical support function is an advantage

• Knowledge of mechanics, pneumatics and hydraulics is advantageous

• Experience in direct customer contact and strong service orientation

• Very good German (minimum B2) and good English skills (minimum B1)

•
Structured, proactive and team-oriented personality with fast comprehension, high personal responsibility and flexibility

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

jobs.title: Senior Process Industrialization Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Shape scalable manufacturing processes and bring products successfully into series production.
As Lead Make, you connect product industrialization, equipment engineering and operations in global projects.

Key Responsibilities

• Be the focal point of process flow and line layout design across global production setups

• Lead end-to-end design and optimization of global manufacturing and assembly processes in industrialization projects

• Act as Lead Make in product creation projects, representing manufacturing processes in the core team

• Drive process industrialization and transparently align product, process and equipment requirements

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Equipment Engineering, Quality, IT and Operations worldwide

• Own implementation, validation and ramp-up of manufacturing processes including pilot runs

• Perform technical risk analyses (PFMEA) and ensure implementation of mitigation measures

• Ensure process capability and monitor performance and stability

• Support continuous improvement initiatives such as automation, cost optimization and global transfers

Required Expertise

• University or technical college degree in engineering (e.g. mechanical, industrial, production) or similar

• At least 7 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, process engineering or industrialization in a global environment

• Strong technical background in device manufacturing, manufacturing equipment and process validation methods (PFMEA, control plans)

• Ability to influence and collaborate across functions, cultures and hierarchy levels

• Structured, analytical and entrepreneurial personality with high ownership and accountability

• Very good English skills (C2); German proficiency (B2-C1) is necessary.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone. .

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Introduction

As Head of Group Treasury , you will shape and further develop Belimo’s global Treasury function at an important stage of its growth. You will take ownership of liquidity planning, cash management, financing, banking relationships, and financial risk management across the Group. This is a hands-on leadership role for a treasury professional who combines strong technical expertise with the ability to understand complex cash flows, build trusted internal relationships, and establish structures that create resilience for Belimo worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and continuously develop the Group Treasury function in alignment with BELIMO’s values and leadership principles.

• Establish reliable global liquidity planning and create transparency across the Group’s cash flows.

• Further develop cash management, cash pooling, and intercompany financing structures across key markets and currencies.

• Define and implement treasury policies, governance frameworks, standards, and internal controls.

• Lead financing activities and manage relationships with banks, investors, rating agencies, and other financing partners.

• Define and oversee hedging strategies for foreign exchange, interest rate, and other treasury-related risks.

• Drive treasury digitalization, automation, process improvements, and high-quality treasury reporting.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

As Head of Group Treasury , you will shape and further develop Belimo’s global Treasury function at an important stage of its growth. You will take ownership of liquidity planning, cash management, financing, banking relationships, and financial risk management across the Group. This is a hands-on leadership role for a treasury professional who combines strong technical expertise with the ability to understand complex cash flows, build trusted internal relationships, and establish structures that create resilience for Belimo worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and continuously develop the Group Treasury function in alignment with BELIMO’s values and leadership principles.

• Establish reliable global liquidity planning and create transparency across the Group’s cash flows.

• Further develop cash management, cash pooling, and intercompany financing structures across key markets and currencies.

• Define and implement treasury policies, governance frameworks, standards, and internal controls.

• Lead financing activities and manage relationships with banks, investors, rating agencies, and other financing partners.

• Define and oversee hedging strategies for foreign exchange, interest rate, and other treasury-related risks.

• Drive treasury digitalization, automation, process improvements, and high-quality treasury reporting.

• Advise Executive Management and Group Finance on strategic initiatives, including M&A, investments, and financing projects.

Required Expertise

• You hold a university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline. A professional treasury qualification and/or MBA is an advantage.

• You bring substantial, relevant experience in corporate treasury, ideally gained in a multinational organization with complex international cash flows and group structures.

• You have practical expertise in liquidity planning, cash management, cash pooling, intercompany financing, and financial risk management.

• You have experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across an international organization, including finance teams, business leaders, subsidiaries, external partners, and financial institutions.

• You are familiar with Treasury Management Systems, banking platforms, treasury digitalization, and the treasury-related implications of IFRS.

• You communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing. German is a strong plus and will help you build meaningful connections across Belimo.

• You are reliable, accountable, and pragmatic, with strong analytical skills and the confidence to make well-founded decisions.

• You are a credible and collaborative leader who builds trust, communicates complex topics clearly, and enjoys developing both people and structures.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Ready for your next step? We look forward to hearing from you.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung

Als Head of Group Treasury werden Sie die globale Treasury-Funktion von Belimo in einer wichtigen Wachstumsphase gestalten und weiterentwickeln. Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für Liquiditätsplanung, Cash Management, Finanzierung, Bankbeziehungen und Finanzrisikomanagement im gesamten Konzern. Dies ist eine praktische Führungsrolle für einen Treasury-Experten, der starkes technisches Know-how mit der Fähigkeit verbindet, komplexe Cashflows zu verstehen, vertrauenswürdige interne Beziehungen aufzubauen und Strukturen aufzubauen, die weltweit Widerstandsfähigkeit für Belimo schaffen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Leitung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Konzern-Treasury-Funktion im Einklang mit den Werten und Führungsprinzipien von BELIMO.

• Etablieren Sie eine zuverlässige globale Liquiditätsplanung und schaffen Sie Transparenz über die Cashflows der Gruppe.

• Weitere Entwicklung von Cash Management, Cash Pooling und unternehmensübergreifenden Finanzierungsstrukturen in wichtigen Märkten und Währungen.

• Definieren und implementieren Sie Treasury-Richtlinien, Governance-Rahmenbedingungen, Standards und interne Kontrollen.

• Leiten Sie die Finanzierungsaktivitäten und verwalten Sie die Beziehungen zu Banken, Investoren, Ratingagenturen und anderen Finanzierungspartnern.

• Definieren und beaufsichtigen Sie Sicherungsstrategien für Devisen-, Zins- und andere Treasury-bezogene Risiken.

• Fördern Sie die Treasury-Digitalisierung, Automatisierung, Prozessverbesserungen und ein hochwertiges Treasury-Reporting.

• Beratung von Executive Management und Group Finance bei strategischen Initiativen, einschließlich M&A, Investitionen und Finanzierungsprojekten.

Erforderliches Fachwissen

• Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer verwandten Disziplin. Eine professionelle Treasury-Qualifikation und / oder MBA ist von Vorteil.

• Sie bringen substanzielle, relevante Erfahrung im Corporate Treasury mit, idealerweise in einer multinationalen Organisation mit komplexen internationalen Cashflows und Gruppenstrukturen.

• Sie verfügen über praktisches Fachwissen in den Bereichen Liquiditätsplanung, Cash Management, Cash Pooling, Unternehmensfinanzierung und Finanzrisikomanagement.

• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Verwaltung komplexer Stakeholder-Beziehungen in einer internationalen Organisation, einschließlich Finanzteams, Führungskräften, Tochtergesellschaften, externen Partnern und Finanzinstituten.

• Sie kennen Treasury Management Systeme, Bankenplattformen, Treasury Digitalisierung und die Treasury-bezogenen Implikationen der IFRS.

• Sie kommunizieren selbstbewusst auf Englisch, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich. Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus und wird Ihnen helfen, sinnvolle Verbindungen in Belimo aufzubauen.

• Sie sind zuverlässig, rechenschaftspflichtig und pragmatisch, mit starken analytischen Fähigkeiten und dem Vertrauen, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

• Sie sind eine glaubwürdige und kooperative Führungskraft, die Vertrauen schafft, komplexe Themen klar kommuniziert und Spaß daran hat, Menschen und Strukturen zu entwickeln.

Menschen in Belimo

Intelligente Gebäude beginnen mit engagierten Menschen. Wir bringen talentierte Menschen zusammen und fördern ein Umfeld, um erfolgreich zu sein. Bei Belimo helfen Respekt, Vertrauen und Unterstützung abteilungsübergreifend, Ideen schnell in reale Lösungen zu bringen, weil wir gemeinsam mehr erreichen, als wir es jemals alleine könnten.

Über Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in der Entwicklung, Produktion und dem Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Steuerung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. Der Fokus unseres Kerngeschäfts liegt auf Dämpferaktoren, Regelventilen, Sensoren und Messgeräten. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Swiss Exchange (SIX) notiert.

Entschädigung und Vorteile

Bei Belimo glauben wir an eine faire, gerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Wir bieten eine Bezahlung an, die Ihre Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Ihren Standort widerspiegelt. Über die Entschädigung hinaus profitieren Sie von einem umfassenden Belohnungspaket, das Ihre Gesundheit, Ihr finanzielles Wohlbefinden und Ihren langfristigen Erfolg unterstützt. Belimo ist stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein.

Bereit für Ihren nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation

En tant que chef du groupe Trésorerie, vous façonnerez et développerez la fonction de Trésorerie mondiale de Belimo à un stade important de sa croissance. Vous serez propriétaire de la planification des liquidités, de la gestion de la trésorerie, du financement, des relations bancaires et de la gestion des risques financiers dans l'ensemble du Groupe. C'est un rôle de leadership pratique pour un professionnel de la trésorerie qui combine une solide expertise technique avec la capacité de comprendre les flux de trésorerie complexes, de construire des relations internes de confiance et d'établir des structures qui créent une résilience pour Belimo dans le monde entier.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger et développer en permanence la fonction de Trésorerie du Groupe conformément aux valeurs et principes de leadership de BELIMO.

• Établir une planification fiable de la liquidité mondiale et créer la transparence des flux de trésorerie du Groupe.

• Développer davantage la gestion de la trésorerie, la mise en commun des liquidités et les structures de financement interentreprises sur les principaux marchés et monnaies.

• Définir et mettre en oeuvre des politiques de trésorerie, des cadres de gouvernance, des normes et des contrôles internes.

• Diriger les activités de financement et gérer les relations avec les banques, les investisseurs, les agences de notation et les autres partenaires financiers.

• Définir et superviser les stratégies de couverture des risques de change, de taux d'intérêt et d'autres risques liés à la trésorerie.

• Favoriser la numérisation, l'automatisation, l'amélioration des processus et l'établissement de rapports de trésorerie de haute qualité.

• Conseiller la direction et les finances de groupe sur les initiatives stratégiques, y compris les fusions-acquisitions, les investissements et le financement de projets.

Expertise requise

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en finance, économie, administration des affaires ou une discipline connexe. Une qualification professionnelle de trésorerie et/ou de MBA est un avantage.

• Vous apportez une expérience importante et pertinente dans la trésorerie des entreprises, idéalement acquise dans une organisation multinationale avec des flux de trésorerie internationaux complexes et des structures de groupe.

• Vous avez une expertise pratique en planification des liquidités, gestion de la trésorerie, gestion de la trésorerie commune, financement interentreprises et gestion des risques financiers.

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion de relations complexes entre les parties prenantes d'une organisation internationale, y compris les équipes financières, les chefs d'entreprise, les filiales, les partenaires externes et les institutions financières.

• Vous connaissez les systèmes de gestion de la trésorerie, les plateformes bancaires, la numérisation de la trésorerie et les implications d'IFRS liées à la trésorerie.

• Vous communiquez avec confiance en anglais, verbalement et par écrit. L'allemand est un plus fort et vous aidera à créer des connexions significatives à travers Belimo.

• Vous êtes fiable, responsable et pragmatique, avec de solides compétences analytiques et la confiance nécessaire pour prendre des décisions fondées.

• Vous êtes un leader crédible et collaboratif qui renforce la confiance, communique clairement des sujets complexes et apprécie le développement des personnes et des structures.

Les gens de Belimo

Les bâtiments intelligents commencent par des personnes dédiées. Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et favorisons un environnement propice au succès. Chez Belimo, le respect, la confiance et le soutien à travers les ministères aident les idées à passer rapidement à des solutions concrètes, parce que nous obtenons plus ensemble que nous ne le pouvions jamais.

À propos de Belimo

Belimo est le leader mondial dans le développement, la production et la vente de dispositifs de terrain pour le contrôle énergétique des systèmes de chauffage, de ventilation et de climatisation. Nos activités principales sont les actionneurs d'amortisseurs, les vannes de commande, les capteurs et les compteurs. Fondée en 1975, la société est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

Chez Belimo, nous croyons en une rémunération juste, équitable et concurrentielle. Nous offrons une rémunération qui reflète vos compétences, votre expérience, vos études et votre emplacement. Au-delà de la rémunération, vous bénéficierez d'un ensemble complet de récompenses conçu pour soutenir votre santé, votre bien-être financier et votre succès à long terme. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur pour l'égalité des chances.

Prêt pour votre prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre.

Introduzione

Insieme a un team altamente motivato, svilupperai segnali misti ASIC che formano il cuore di ogni unità e sensore Belimo e sono prodotti milioni di volte. Si assume la responsabilità tecnica della parte analogica, sviluppata esternamente dal nostro fornitore ASIC.

Principali responsabilità

• Specificazione e verifica della parte analogica dei nostri ASIC

• Una stretta collaborazione con il nostro fornitore ASIC e la risoluzione congiunta delle sfide tecniche nello sviluppo della parte analogica

• Interfaccia tecnica al team interno digitale e al team di verifica del sistema che controlla gli ASIC all'interno dei dispositivi Belimo

• Sviluppo e manutenzione di circuiti stampati per lo sviluppo e la qualificazione di ASIC

• Progettazione di circuiti analogici di nuove funzioni

Competenza necessaria

•
Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Elettrica, idealmente con un focus su Microelettronica o Analog Electronics

•
Diversi anni di esperienza nella progettazione e nella tecnologia di misura dei circuiti analogici, compresi i metodi di ingegneria e verifica dei requisiti

•
L'esperienza nel campo della microelettronica è un grande vantaggio

•

Main responsibilities

People at Belimo

Maîtrise en génie électrique, idéalement axée sur la microélectronique ou l'électronique analogique

L'expérience dans le domaine de la microélectronique est un grand plus

Intérêt pour la conception de circuits numériques (Vérilog ou VHDL)

Enthousiasme pour les nouvelles technologies et les idées innovantes, un haut niveau d'initiative, une grande sensibilisation à la qualité et une méthode de travail indépendante

Personnalité ouverte et communicative avec une connaissance fiable de l'allemand et de l'anglais

Les gens de Belimo

Les moteurs à flammes, les vannes de commande, les capteurs et les compteurs forment notre activité principale. Fondée en 1975, la société est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

jobs.title: ASIC Development Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Together with a highly motivated team, you will develop mixed-signal ASICs, which form the core of every Belimo actuator or sensor produced in the millions. You will have technical responsibility for the analog part, which is designed externally by our ASIC supplier.

Key Responsibilities

• Specification and Verification of the analog part of the ASIC

• Close cooperation and problem solving together with the ASIC supplier (that develops the analog part)

• Technical interface to the internal digital part team, as well as to the internal system verification team (that verifies the ASIC within a Belimo device)

• Development and maintenance of circuit boards used for the development and qualification of the ASICs

• Analog circuit design of new functions

Required Expertise

• Master's degree in electrical engineering, ideally with a specialization in microelectronics or analog electronics

• Several years of experience in analog circuit design and measurement technology including requirements engineering and verification methods

• Experience in microelectronics is a big plus

• Interest in digital circuit design (Verilog or VHDL)

• Enthusiasm for new technologies and innovative ideas, commitment, a strong focus on quality, and the ability to work independently

• An open, outgoing personality, as well as business-level proficiency in German and English

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone. .

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Impiliamo e costruiamo. Stiamo cercando rinforzi per tre delle nostre squadre logistiche. Si mantiene una panoramica anche ad alta velocità e garantire con la vostra esperienza che i flussi di merci dal ricevimento alla spedizione funzionano senza problemi? Se ti piace affrontare, assumerti la responsabilità e fare la differenza in un ambiente internazionale, sei al posto giusto con noi.

In questi modelli a turni si mantiene la logistica in esecuzione con noi:

Stoccaggio

• 2 turni dalle 06:00 alle 23:00

• 06:00 - 15:15

• 14:00 - 23:00

Intralogistica

• 3 turni dalle 06:00 alle 23:00

• 06:00 - 15:30

• 07:00 - 16:30

Dispiace

• 06:30 - 15:40

• 12:00 - 21:10

Cosa farai

• Movimento fisico e trasporto di merci incl. Caricamento/scarico, stoccaggio e trasferimento

• Uso sicuro dei camion industriali

• Controlla la quantità e la qualità delle merci

• Acquisto, configurazione e fornitura di materiali e ordini del cliente

• Rilevamento corretto di tutti i movimenti materiali nel sistema SAP-EWM

• Cooperazione con le aree logistiche adiacenti e sostegno agli inventari

• Rispetto di tutti i requisiti di sicurezza e qualità, nonché la partecipazione ai miglioramenti dei processi

Chi sei

• Apprendistato professionale completo come logistico: in EFZ

• Almeno 4 anni di esperienza professionale in un'azienda industriale, commerciale o logistica internazionale

• Patente di guida per carrelli elevatori

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura

• Pronunciato:r Teamplayer:in con un metodo di lavoro indipendente ed esatto

• Buone condizioni fisiche (buon fitness)

• Prontezza per cambiare orario di lavoro tra le 6:00 e le 23:00, vedi sopra

• Conoscenza di MS Office e SAP (MM/EWM)

• Il pensiero economico e orientato alla soluzione

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e promuovono nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, ma anche rivoluzionano l'industria HVAC. Investire nei nostri dipendenti è al centro di Belimo quando si tratta di coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per costruire una società leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We stack up and build up. We are looking for reinforcements for three of our logistics teams. You keep an overview even at high speed and ensure with your experience that flows of goods from receipt to shipping run smoothly? If you like to tackle, take responsibility and make a difference in an international environment, you are at the right place with us.

In these shift models you keep the logistics running with us:

Storage

• 2 shifts between 06:00 and 23:00

• 06:00 - 15:15

• 14:00 - 23:00

Intralogistics

• 3 shifts between 06:00 and 23:00

• 06:00 - 15:30

• 07:00 - 16:30

Dispatch

• 06:30 - 15:40

• 12:00 - 21:10

What will you do

• Physical movement and transport of goods incl. Loading/unloading, storage and relocation

• Safe use of industrial trucks

• Checks on quantity and quality of goods

• Order picking, set-up and provision of materials and customer orders

• Correct detection of all material movements in the SAP-EWM system

• Cooperation with adjacent logistics areas and support for inventories

• Compliance with all safety and quality requirements as well as participation in process improvements

Who you are

• Completed vocational apprenticeship as a logistician:in EFZ

• At least 4 years of professional experience in an international industrial, commercial or logistics company

• Forklift driving licence

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing

• Pronounced:r Teamplayer:in with an independent and exact working method

• Good physical condition (good fitness)

• Readiness for changing working hours between 6:00 and 23:00, see above

• Knowledge of MS Office and SAP (MM/EWM)

• Economic and solution-oriented thinking

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

jobs.title: Intellectual Property Expert (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Introduction

As an Intellectual Property Expert for the Digital Ecosystem, you will play a key role in protecting and developing the company's intellectual property portfolio. Working closely with external patent attorneys, technical experts, and business stakeholders, you will help drive the IP strategy, support innovation activities, and provide expert guidance on patents, designs, and broader IP matters.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage, maintain, and renew the patent and design portfolio relating to the Digital Ecosystem in line with the company's IP strategy and budget requirements.

• Support invention disclosures and patent applications, including prior art and patentability searches.

• Ensure appropriate Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) assessments are carried out in IP-relevant projects.

• Coordinate and evaluate patent searches, competitive intelligence activities, and IP monitoring.

• Advise and support business units on patent and design matters through training, workshops, reporting, and consultation.

• Represent the Intellectual Property function in cross-functional meetings and technical discussions.

• Administer assigned parts of the company's intellectual property portfolio and related processes.

• Contribute to broader IP topics such as copyrights, trade secrets, NDAs, licensing agreements, R&D contracts, disputes, and IP strategy implementation projects.

Required Expertise

• Degree in Engineering, Natural Sciences, or a related technical field, combined with recognized IP qualification or substantial experience in intellectual property.

• Several years of experience in an industrial environment or consulting role related to intellectual property.

• Solid understanding of patents, designs, and intellectual property management as well as expertise in (embedded) software development.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with external patent attorneys and service providers.

• Strong capability to quickly understand and support multiple technical disciplines simultaneously.

• Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain and summarize complex topics for different stakeholder groups.

• High level of initiative with a structured, reliable, precise, and detail-oriented working style.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone. .

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Introduction

As a Working Student Packaging Engineering, you support the development, optimization, and documentation of packaging and labelling solutions across our product portfolio. Working closely with Packaging Engineers and cross-functional teams, you contribute to packaging tests, technical documentation, and sustainability initiatives while gaining valuable hands-on experience in an international environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze and document the status quo of the Belimo packaging portfolio

• Support the Packaging Engineering team in developing, documenting, and optimizing packaging and labelling solutions

• Assist in creating and maintaining packaging specifications, technical documentation, and packaging instructions

• Help with packaging tests, prototype evaluations, sample preparation, and documentation of test results

• Collect, structure, and evaluate information on packaging materials, sustainability topics, regulations, and industry trends

Required Expertise

•
 Ongoing studies in Packaging Engineering, Packaging Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Materials Science, Sustainability, or a comparable technical field

•
 Experience or a strong interest in packaging development, technical documentation, data maintenance, and testing

•
 Interest in sustainability-related topics, packaging materials, regulations, and industry trends

•
 Native-level German or German proficiency (B1-B2) is required; very good English skills (B2) are required

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone. .

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione

In qualità di Working Student Packaging Engineering, supporta lo sviluppo, l'ottimizzazione e la documentazione delle soluzioni di imballaggio e etichettatura nel nostro portafoglio prodotti. Lavorando a stretto contatto con gli Ingegneri di Imballaggio e i team interfunzionali, si contribuisce a test di imballaggio, documentazione tecnica e iniziative di sostenibilità, acquisendo al contempo preziosa esperienza pratica in un ambiente internazionale.

Principali responsabilità

• Analizzare e documentare lo status quo del portafoglio di imballaggi Belimo

• Sostenere il team di Packaging Engineering nello sviluppo, nella documentazione e nell'ottimizzazione delle soluzioni di imballaggio e etichettatura

• Assistere nella creazione e manutenzione di specifiche di imballaggio, documentazione tecnica e istruzioni di imballaggio

• Aiuta con i test di imballaggio, le valutazioni dei prototipi, la preparazione dei campioni e la documentazione dei risultati dei test

• Raccogliere, strutturare e valutare le informazioni sui materiali di imballaggio, temi di sostenibilità, regolamenti e tendenze del settore

Competenza richiesta

•
Studi in corso in ingegneria dell'imballaggio, tecnologia dell'imballaggio, ingegneria meccanica, progettazione industriale, scienza dei materiali, sostenibilità, o un campo tecnico comparabile

•
Esperienza o un forte interesse per lo sviluppo dell'imballaggio, documentazione tecnica, manutenzione dei dati e test

•
Interessi in materia di sostenibilità, materiali di imballaggio, regolamenti e tendenze del settore

•
È richiesta una competenza tedesca o tedesca di livello nativo (B1-B2); sono necessarie competenze in inglese molto buone (B2)

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti iniziano con persone dedicate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e adottiamo un ambiente per avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il supporto nei dipartimenti aiutano le idee a muoversi rapidamente in soluzioni del mondo reale, perché raggiungiamo più insieme di quanto non potremmo mai soli.

About Belimo

Belimo è leader del mercato globale nello sviluppo, produzione e vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'energia dei sistemi di riscaldamento, ventilazione e climatizzazione. Il focus del nostro core business è sugli attuatori ammortizzatori, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata sulla Borsa Svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Compensazioni e vantaggi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, equa e competitiva. Offriamo la paga che riflette le vostre abilità, esperienza, istruzione e la posizione. Oltre alla compensazione, potrete beneficiare di un pacchetto completo di ricompense progettato per sostenere la vostra salute, benessere finanziario e successo a lungo termine. Belimo è orgogliosa di essere un Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Trusted Firmware Verification Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Introduction

We are looking for an experienced Trusted Firmware Verification Engineer to integrate, test, and validate secure embedded firmware solutions. The role combines vendor management with technical ownership in the fields of cybersecurity, firmware verification, and test automation for ARM-based platforms.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform test specification and implementation of embedded firmware and security-related software components, validation, debugging, and root-cause analysis.

• Design and execute automated test solutions and validation frameworks.

• Implement and verify Secure Boot, Secure Update, Secure Storage, Secure Recovery, and Firmware Signing.

• Coordinate external development packages and assume ownership of selected deliverables.

• Support firmware release, maintenance, and security compliance activities.

• Review requirements specifications

Required Expertise

• BSc or MSc in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience in embedded software development, firmware testing, and debugging of embedded devices.

• Knowledge of Trusted Firmware-M (TF-M), PSA APIs, secure firmware concepts, and security-focused embedded systems.

• Experience with verification and validation methodologies, including white-box and black-box testing.

• Familiarity with test automation frameworks and automated validation environments, ideally Robot Framework.

• Good understanding of ARM Cortex architectures, RTOS-based systems, and embedded communication protocols.

• Proficiency in Embedded C++ and Python

• Fluent English communication skills

Qui vous êtes

• Expérience des méthodes de vérification et de validation, y compris les essais en boîtes blanches et en boîtes noires.

• Bonne compréhension des architectures ARM Cortex, des systèmes RTOS et des protocoles de communication embarqués.

• Compétences de communication en anglais

Einführung

Als Senior HR Manager EMEA bist Du Sparring Partner für Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende in einem internationalen Umfeld. Du begleitest Organisationen durch Wachstum, Veränderung und Weiterentwicklung und bringst strategische sowie operative HR-Themen wirkungsvoll zusammen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Business Leaders, den lokalen HR-Teams sowie den globalen HR-Funktionen gestaltest Du die Zukunft unserer Organisation aktiv mit. Dabei übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Umsetzung von HR-Initiativen, der Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmenskultur sowie der Förderung von Talenten und Führungskräften.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Beratung und Begleitung von Führungskräften in sämtlichen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen als vertrauensvoller Sparring Partner am Hauptsitz und in den Ländergesellschaften von EMEA.

• Unterstützung in den Bereichen Organisationsentwicklung, Workforce Planning, und Change Management.

• Förderung der Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften sowie Begleitung von Performance-Management- und Entwicklungsprozessen.

• Koordination und Begleitung sämtlicher HR Prozesse über den gesamten Employee life cycle (z.B. Salärrunden, Talent Management, Nachfolgeplanung und Performance Dialogues).

• Verantwortung für die Besetzung von Schlüsselpositionen gemeinsam mit Talent Acquisition und den Hiring Managern.

• Support und/oder Leitung von HR-Initiativen und Projekten über Länder- und Funktionsgrenzen hinweg.

• Beratung in arbeitsrechtlichen Fragestellungen sowie Nutzung von HR-Daten und modernen Technologien zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Entscheidungen.

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

• Höhere Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

• Fundierte und langjährige Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Senior-HR-Funktion in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsrechts

• Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Ländergesellschaften, Regionen oder Business Units.

• Ausgewiesene Erfolge in der Beratung und Begleitung von Führungskräften auf unterschiedlichen Managementstufen.

• Tiefgehende Erfahrung in Organisationsentwicklung, Talent Management, Nachfolgeplanung und Change Management.

• Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strategische, umsetzungsstarke und integre Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Beratungskompetenz.

Menschen bei Belimo

Intelligente Gebäude entstehen durch engagierte Menschen. Wir bringen talentierte Menschen zusammen und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sie erfolgreich sein können. Bei Belimo tragen Respekt, Vertrauen und gegenseitige Unterstützung über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg dazu bei, dass aus Ideen rasch praktische Lösungen werden. Denn gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr, als wir alleine je erreichen könnten.

Über Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Regelung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. Klappenantriebe, Regelventile, Sensoren und Zähler bilden dabei unser Kerngeschäft. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Schweizer Börse (SIX) kotiert.

Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen

Wir bei Belimo glauben an eine faire, gerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Wir bieten ein Gehalt, das deinen Fähigkeiten, deiner Erfahrung, deiner Ausbildung und deinem Einsatzort entspricht. Neben der Vergütung profitierst du von umfassenden Zusatzleistungen, die dein mentales, körperliches, finanzielles und soziales Wohlbefinden unterstützen. Belimo ist stolz darauf, eine Arbeitgeberin zu sein, die Chancengleichheit fördert.

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e promuovono nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, ma anche rivoluzionano l'industria HVAC. Investire nei nostri dipendenti è al centro di Belimo quando si tratta di coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per costruire una società leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Guidate e allenate i vostri team attraverso una forte fase di crescita, ottimizzate i processi e tenete in funzione il nostro mondo della logistica – dal ricevimento delle merci ai robot high-bay. Se ti senti come assumere la leadership, padroneggiare i processi e guidare l'innovazione, sei al posto giusto con noi.

Cosa farai

• Guidare, motivare, sviluppare: rafforzare e sviluppare i vostri leader e dipendenti del team (totale circa 80 dipendenti) in modo mirato, promuovere competenze di leadership e accompagnare l'organizzazione attraverso una fase di crescita dinamica.

• Personale di masterizzazione e pianificazione delle assegnazioni: Pianificazione ottimale dei turni (3 turni), gestione delle emergenze e gestione delle risorse sono nelle vostre mani.

• Prestazioni, qualità e costi sotto controllo: Lei è responsabile per la ricevuta di merci, lo stoccaggio, la raccolta, lo smaltimento e la spedizione – compresi i bilanci, l'inventario e la gestione dell'inventario.

• Tecnologia e funzionamento degli impianti: Garantisci la disponibilità di tutti gli impianti (inclusi i magazzini di alta sicurezza e piccole parti altamente automatizzati e il magazzino esterno).

• Ottimizzare i processi logistici: Qualità ed efficienza – Si sviluppano processi ulteriormente, procurano beni di capitale e garantiscono la loro manutenzione sostenibile e il miglioramento continuo nel senso del CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: sicurezza del lavoro, salute, ambiente, requisiti legali, norme ISO e linee guida interne Tieni tutto e lo sviluppi ulteriormente.

• Reporting & Control: Le statistiche, i rapporti KPI e BSC servono come base per monitorare e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni logistiche.

• Qualità & Progetti: Supporto per casi di qualità, comunicazioni di processo e partecipazione attiva a progetti rilevanti.

Chi sei

• Formazione professionale tecnica o logistica completa (ad es. logistica/EFZ) e formazione specialistica superiore nella logistica

• Molti anni di esperienza manageriale con responsabilità per grandi squadre (almeno 80 persone) e la capacità di accompagnare e sviluppare team e manager in un campo di crescita dinamico

• Mente. 10 anni di esperienza professionale in aziende industriali, commerciali o logistiche internazionali nel campo delle operazioni con focus sulla logistica

• Esperienza approfondita nella riuscita realizzazione di iniziative di eccellenza operativa, ottimizzazione dei processi, gestione dei cambiamenti e progetti di trasformazione trasversale

• Molto buone competenze IT e SAP (SD, MM, PP, EWM) e comunicazione sicura in tedesco (minimo C1) e inglese (minimo B2)

• pensiero imprenditoriale, piacere decisionale e alta indipendenza

• Team player con assertività: forti capacità di comunicazione, competenza di conflitto, affidabilità e metodi di lavoro strutturati

• Prerequisiti pratici: test di stacker elettrodo e prontezza per il lavoro a turni

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e promuovono nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, ma anche rivoluzionano l'industria HVAC. Investire nei nostri dipendenti è al centro di Belimo quando si tratta di coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per costruire una società leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You lead and coach your teams through a strong growth phase, optimize processes and keep our logistics world running – from goods receipt to high-bay robots. If you feel like taking on leadership, mastering processes and driving innovation, you are at the right place with us.

What will you do

• Lead, motivate, develop: You will strengthen and develop your team leaders and employees (total about 80 employees) in a targeted manner, promote leadership skills and accompany the organization through a dynamic growth phase.

• Mastering personnel and assignment planning: Optimal shift planning (3-shift operation), emergency management and resource management are in your hands.

• Performance, quality and costs under control: You are responsible for goods receipt, storage, picking, disposal and shipping – including budgets, inventory and inventory management.

• Technology & plant operation: You ensure the availability of all plants (including highly automated high-bay and small parts warehouse and external external warehouse).

• Optimize logistics processes: Quality and efficiency – You develop processes further, procure capital goods and ensure their sustainable maintenance and continuous improvement in the sense of the CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: occupational safety, health, environment, legal requirements, ISO standards and internal guidelines You keep everything and develop it further.

• Reporting & Control: Statistics, KPI and BSC reports serve as a basis for you to continuously monitor and improve logistics performance.

• Quality & Projects: Support for quality cases, process communications and active participation in relevant projects.

Who you are

• Completed technical or logistical vocational training (e.g. logistician/EFZ) plus higher specialist training in logistics

• Many years of management experience with responsibility for large teams (at least 80 people) as well as the ability to accompany and develop teams and managers in a dynamic growth field

• Mind. 10 years of professional experience in international industrial, commercial or logistics companies in the field of operations with focus on logistics

• In-depth experience in the successful implementation of operational excellence initiatives, process optimization, change management and cross-divisional transformation projects

• Very good IT and SAP skills (SD, MM, PP, EWM) and secure communication in German (minimum C1) and English (minimum B2)

• Entrepreneurial thinking, decision-making pleasure and high independence

• Team player with assertiveness: strong communication skills, conflict competence, reliability and structured working methods

• Practical prerequisites: electrode stacker testing and readiness for shift work

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

Vous dirigez et coachez vos équipes à travers une phase de croissance forte, optimisez les processus et maintenez notre monde logistique en marche – de la réception des marchandises aux robots à grande baie. Si vous avez envie de prendre le leadership, de maîtriser les processus et de stimuler l'innovation, vous êtes au bon endroit avec nous.

Que ferez-vous ?

• Dirigez, motivez, développez : Vous renforcerez et développerez vos chefs d'équipe et vos employés (environ 80 employés) de manière ciblée, favoriserez les compétences en leadership et accompagnerez l'organisation dans une phase de croissance dynamique.

• Maîtriser le personnel et la planification des affectations : La planification optimale des postes (3 postes), la gestion des urgences et la gestion des ressources sont entre vos mains.

• Performance, qualité et coûts sous contrôle : Vous êtes responsable de la réception, de l'entreposage, de la cueillette, de l'élimination et de l'expédition des marchandises – y compris les budgets, les stocks et la gestion des stocks.

• Technologie & exploitation de l'usine: Vous assurez la disponibilité de toutes les usines (y compris l'entrepôt haute baie et petites pièces hautement automatisé et l'entrepôt externe externe).

• Optimiser les processus logistiques : Qualité et efficacité – Vous développez les processus, achetez des biens d'équipement et assurez leur maintenance durable et leur amélioration continue au sens du CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: sécurité au travail, santé, environnement, exigences légales, normes ISO et lignes directrices internes Vous gardez tout et développez plus loin.

• Reporting & Control: Les statistiques, les rapports KPI et BSC servent de base au suivi et à l'amélioration continus des performances logistiques.

• Qualité & Projets: Soutien à des cas de qualité, à la communication des processus et à la participation active à des projets pertinents.

Qui vous êtes

• Formation professionnelle technique ou logistique terminée (par exemple logisticien/EFZ) plus formation spécialisée supérieure en logistique

• De nombreuses années d'expérience en gestion avec la responsabilité de grandes équipes (au moins 80 personnes) ainsi que la capacité d'accompagner et de développer des équipes et des gestionnaires dans un domaine de croissance dynamique

• De rien. 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les entreprises industrielles, commerciales ou logistiques internationales dans le domaine des opérations en mettant l'accent sur la logistique

• Expérience approfondie de la mise en œuvre réussie des initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle, de l'optimisation des processus, de la gestion du changement et des projets de transformation interdivisions

• Très bonnes compétences informatiques et SAP (SD, MM, PP, EWM) et communication sécurisée en allemand (minimum C1) et en anglais (minimum B2)

• Pensée entrepreneuriale, plaisir de prendre des décisions et grande indépendance

• Joueur d'équipe avec assertion: fortes compétences en communication, compétence en conflit, fiabilité et méthodes de travail structurées

• Prérequis pratiques: essais de empileur d'électrodes et préparation au travail posté

Chez Belimo, nous sommes fiers de faire de notre entreprise un lieu de travail enrichissant. Nos dirigeants sont motivés par la valeur et font la promotion de nouvelles idées dans leurs équipes à travers le monde. Grâce à notre passion, nos employés non seulement créent des produits étonnants, mais révolutionnent également l'industrie du CVC. Le succès de notre marque est basé sur la compétence et l'engagement de chaque individu.
